title: Inhaled corticosteroids in the management of persistent asthma
text: Inhaled corticosteroids are the cornerstone of long-term asthma control, acting to reduce airway inflammation by suppressing the recruitment and activation of eosinophils and other inflammatory cells within the bronchial mucosa. Regular use has been shown to reduce exacerbation frequency and improve lung function in patients with persistent symptoms.
